200.description: All projects visible to the current user, ordered per their saved project ordering.

guid.title: Guid
guid.description: Unique identifier of the project, matching its directory name under `projects/`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what the workflow does.

node_count.title: Node Count
node_count.description: Number of nodes currently in the workflow's graph.

auto_start.title: Auto Start
auto_start.description: Whether the runtime starts this workflow automatically at boot.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Workflows belonging to this project, keyed by workflow ID. Empty when the caller is not a collaborator.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

value.title: Value
value.description: Stored value for this entry. When `secret` is true, this is the Fernet ciphertext, never the plaintext - the editor round-trips it verbatim through a masked input, and PROJupdateVariables re-encrypts only if the resubmitted value has changed.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Whether this entry holds a secret value.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Project-level variables. Empty when the caller is not a collaborator.

git.description: Git configuration for the project. Empty when the caller is not a collaborator.

ssh_url.title: Ssh Url
ssh_url.description: SSH remote URL configured for the project's git repository, if any.

git.title: GitConfig

accessible.title: Accessible
accessible.description: Whether the caller is a collaborator, and so may open the project's contents.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: All projects visible to the current user, ordered per their saved project ordering.
